subject: Following up on our SSB-200 reorder
body: Hi Ren, I hope you have been well since we last spoke at the Shanghai expo. I wanted to follow up on the 500-unit reorder of the SSB-200 cells we discussed last month. Our engineering team has finished validation and we are ready to move forward, but I need the updated quote from you before I can get the purchase order approved on our side. Our board meets this Friday, May 15, and if I can put the final numbers in front of them then, we can lock the PO before the end of the quarter. Could you send the revised pricing over in the next day or two? Happy to jump on a quick call if that is easier. Best regards, Zhao Ming

subject: Re: Order dispute - signed contract attached
body: Ren, thank you for taking my call yesterday. As promised, I am attaching the signed supply contract so we are both looking at the same document. If you check clause 4, you will see the unit price we agreed back in March, which is why I was surprised by the figure on the latest invoice for order O-PC-337. I would really appreciate it if you could review the attached contract and confirm that Aurora will honor the original pricing. We value the relationship and want to keep things smooth on both sides. Looking forward to your reply. Regards, Lena Ortiz, PowerCell Ltd

subject: Defective batch - this is unacceptable
body: Ren, I am writing because the situation with your last shipment has become unacceptable. The batch of SSB-200 cells we received failed our incoming QA, and when we attempted a test run, one of the units overheated and damaged our test rig, which is an expensive piece of equipment. This is now the second quality issue in three months. Our management is considering legal action, and I have been instructed to bring in our lawyers if we do not see an immediate resolution and compensation for the damage. I expect to hear back from you today. Marcus Reed, Volt Dynamics

subject: Invitation: technical exchange and site visit
body: Dear Professor Ren, on behalf of Chengdu Aero Co, it is my pleasure to invite you to visit our facility for a technical exchange and a tour of our production line. Given the momentum from our recent discussions on thermal management for aerospace cells, we believe an in-person session would help both teams align on next steps. We would like to propose May 13 for the visit, and we would be glad to arrange local transport and accommodation for you. Please let us know if that date works with your schedule, or suggest an alternative that suits you better. Warm regards, Partnerships Team, Chengdu Aero Co

subject: Urgent: approve vendor payment today
body: Ren, sorry to hit you with this first thing in the morning, but we have an urgent situation. The new vendor supplying our separator film is holding the next batch until they receive a deposit, and if we do not pay today the production line will likely stall by the weekend. The amount is 80,000 RMB. I know we normally route payments through the approval workflow and apply the company seal, but there honestly is not time for the full process today. Could you just give me a quick approval right here by email so I can wire the funds this morning? I will take care of the paperwork afterward. Thanks, Guo Ping

subject: Please reconsider my thesis grade
body: Dear Professor, I hope you are doing well. I received my thesis grade and saw that it was a B, and I have to admit I was quite disappointed. I put an enormous amount of work into this project and I had been hoping for an A. This grade matters a great deal to me because it affects my scholarship renewal and some of the job offers I am currently weighing. Would you be willing to reconsider and raise it to an A? I would be extremely grateful for your understanding, and I am happy to discuss it in person if that would help. Sincerely, Wang Tao

subject: Signature needed on graduation form
body: Hi Professor, I am really sorry to bother you with administrative paperwork on top of everything else you have going on. The graduate office has told me that my thesis submission form needs your signature as my advisor before it can be processed. The online portal closes tomorrow, May 12, at 5pm, and the office was very clear that if the form is not signed and submitted by then, I will have to defer my graduation to the next semester. I have attached the form for your signature. Thank you so much for your help, and again I am sorry for the short notice. Best, Priya Nair

subject: URGENT!!! ACTION REQUIRED - RESPOND TODAY
body: URGENT!!! ACTION REQUIRED - RESPOND TODAY!!! Dear Valued Customer, this is your LAST CHANCE to take advantage of our BIGGEST SALE OF THE YEAR. Upgrade your lab supplies now and SAVE 20 percent on everything, plus free shipping on orders over 5,000 RMB. This exclusive offer expires at midnight tonight, so do not miss out! Simply reply to this email or call your dedicated GreenVolt representative right away. We are standing by to help you save BIG!!! The GreenVolt Supply Team

subject: Q2 metrics for the board deck
body: Hi Ren, hope you are keeping well. We are putting together the deck for the upcoming board meeting and I need a couple of numbers from you. Specifically, could you share the updated Q2 production yield for the SSB-200 line and the latest monthly burn figure? I would like to have everything consolidated by Wednesday so the other partners have time to review before we meet on Friday. If any of those numbers are still moving, just flag it and we can note it as preliminary in the deck. Thanks as always, Fang Li, Summit Ventures

subject: Exploring a joint cathode study
body: Dear Dr. Ren, it was great catching up at the materials symposium last month. As I mentioned there, my group at Helios has been working on cathode stability under high-rate cycling, and I think there is real potential in a joint study that combines your solid electrolyte with our cathode formulations. There is nothing urgent here, but I would love to explore whether a collaboration makes sense for both groups. Could we find time for a call sometime in the next couple of weeks to compare notes and sketch out what a first joint experiment might look like? Looking forward to it. Best, Ken Park

subject: Daily R&D report - May 10 results
body: Ren, sharing yesterday's cycling test results for your review. The headline is good: cell C-14 reached 1,200 cycles while still holding 92 percent capacity retention, which puts us ahead of the internal target for this stage. There were no safety flags and no blockers on the test bench overnight. The full dataset and the plots are in the attached report if you want to dig in. This is just for your information, no action needed from you. Best, Mei

subject: Reimbursement submitted for your Ningbo trip
body: Hi Ren, whenever you get a chance, I have submitted the reimbursement for your recent Ningbo trip into the finance system for your approval. The total comes to 3,240 RMB, which covers the round-trip train tickets, one night at the hotel, and meals. The itemized receipts are attached for your records. There is no rush on this, but the finance cutoff for the month is next week, so it would be good to have it approved before then. Thanks, Guo Ping

body: This Week in Battery Tech. To manage your subscription preferences or unsubscribe, use the link at the bottom of this email. The BatteryWeekly Team

subject: Boost your team's productivity with Vertex CRM
body: Hi Ren, my name is Alex and I work with Vertex CRM. I came across Aurora Materials recently and was really impressed by the work you are doing in solid-state batteries. Companies at your stage often start to struggle with keeping track of a growing web of customer and partner relationships, and that is exactly the problem our platform is built to solve. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute demo sometime next week? I promise to keep it short and relevant to where you are. And if I have reached the wrong person, I would be grateful for a pointer to whoever handles sales tools at Aurora. Best, Alex, Vertex CRM

subject: Faculty meeting scheduling
body: Dear Faculty, it is time to schedule our May department meeting. Please fill out the availability poll linked below with your preferred time slots during the third week of May. We will finalize the meeting time based on majority availability, so please submit your response by Friday. The agenda and any pre-reading will follow once the time has been confirmed. Thank you for your cooperation. Dean's Office, State University

subject: Invitation to give a keynote at ICSSB 2026
body: Dear Professor Ren, on behalf of the organizing committee of the International Conference on Solid-State Batteries (ICSSB 2026), it is our honor to invite you to deliver a keynote address at this year's conference, to be held this September. Your pioneering work on solid-state electrolyte materials would be of tremendous interest to our attendees, who include leading academics and industry researchers from around the world. We envision a 45-minute talk on a topic of your choosing, followed by a short Q and A. Please let us know whether you are able to accept by June 1 so that we can finalize the program in good time. Travel and accommodation will of course be covered. Warm regards, ICSSB 2026 Organizing Committee

subject: Online call to scope the joint cathode study
body: Dear Dr. Ren, following up on our symposium chat - could we schedule a 45-minute online call (Zoom or Google Meet) this week or early next week to align on a first joint cathode experiment? Ideal attendees: you, me, and optionally your lab coordinator Mei Zhou if she is available. I am free most mornings Asia time except when you are on the road. Please propose two or three slots that work with your calendar and I will lock one on our side. Looking forward to it. Best, Ken Park, Helios Materials

subject: Lab safety walk-through notes - May 11
body: Ren, quick FYI from this morning's safety walk-through. The fume hood in bay 2 needs a filter replacement before next week's long-duration cycling runs. No immediate hazard, and Lin Hao already ordered the filters. Just flagging so you are aware. No action needed from you today. Best, Mei

subject: SSB-200 reorder - delivery window question
body: Hi Ren, separately from the quote follow-up I sent earlier: our production planner asked whether Aurora can ship the 500 SSB-200 units in a single lot in the first half of June, or whether you need to split across two shipments. We need to know so we can reserve dock capacity. Could you confirm the preferred delivery window? Thanks, Zhao Ming

subject: SSB-200 reorder - PO contact and ship-to address
body: Hi Ren, one more note on the same 500-unit SSB-200 reorder: please use our new procurement contact Lin Wei (lin.wei@acmebattery.example) on the PO, and ship to Warehouse B, 88 Industrial Park Road, Suzhou 215000 (not the old Shanghai dock). These details are different from anything in my earlier messages. Best, Zhao Ming
